name: Yellowstone
source: Yellowstone is the manifestation of Yellowstone National Park. Her favorite activities include hiking, biking, running, picnics, and spinning in circles until she collapses. Unfortunately, she's been tasked with the general upkeep of the living quarters, so she hardly ever gets to have her fun. The volcano on top of her head erupts with lava when she's angry, and bursts with a geyser of water when she's sad--and it does both often, giving that she's both very emotional and very excitable. Despite this, Yellowstone is always willing to lend a hand, her enthusiasm and pep helping to make the lonely cabin a little warmer. Even if she does talk like a 50's greaser.
